Throughout the pandemic, our nation has seen the need for mental health services increase as Americans experience anxiety and depression at higher rates.

In 2019, 1 in 10 adults in the U.S. reported these symptoms, but since COVID, this rate has gone up! https://t.co/hHk9PXRLa0

Substance use, overdose deaths, & suicide affect millions of Americans every year, & many can't get the support & care they need. 
 
Our policies must deliver accessible, quality care & treatment to those suffering from addiction and other mental illnesses. https://t.co/Vg8qBHiqwK

ICYMI: The @WaysMeansCmte held a hearing this week on “Substance Use, Suicide Risk & the American Health System.” Substance use disorders affect our whole society and communities continue to suffer. Ensuring all Americans have access to lifesaving treatment and care is critical. https://t.co/IuafkoH4vC

The #COVID19 pandemic has exacerbated our nation’s mental health crisis and highlighted barriers to treatment. 

Today we're talking to @HHSGov @SecBecerra about how the #BidenBudget expands coverage and reduces costs for mental health services. https://t.co/jzDwItzISJ

.@MountHolyoke's PaGE program is leading the way in addressing the growing crisis of teacher burnout in our nation’s public schools. With a $250,000 earmark, they will be able to support teacher wellness & student social-emotional learning in high-risk areas in CD-1 & nationwide. https://t.co/Fh7LBToCGV

Westfield Wastewater Treatment Plant is a reminder that our nation's infrastructure is aging. That's why I fought to secure $1M to construct a new operations building center, ensuring the dedicated public servants at the DPW can continue their critical work in a safe environment. https://t.co/XC500XDkfv

Last week, I joined Hampden County Sheriff Nick Cocchi and @HHSGov Region 1 Director Everett Handford for a roundtable discussion at the All-Inclusive Support Services Center on effective substance use disorder treatment and re-entry efforts. https://t.co/fireMXKzEG

Today we celebrate the 1 year anniversary of the Inflation Reduction Act. In 1 year, we have:

👷‍♂️Created 170,000 good-paying jobs
🩺Lowered healthcare costs, saving families an average of $2400 on health premiums
⚡Lowered energy costs & made historic investments in clean energy https://t.co/yg55VPjEHS

Last year, House Democrats passed the PACT Act, delivering health care coverage and lower health care costs for hundreds of thousands of veterans across the country. On this Veterans Day, learn how the PACT Act can help the service members in your life ⤵️
https://t.co/0DxK2V64RY https://t.co/pbnKNxH2bg

A record 20 MILLION Americans enrolled in health care coverage through the Affordable Care Act. 

Thank you, @POTUS. Thank you, @BarackObama.

https://t.co/FgBK1Q1B3B

More than 21 MILLION Americans enrolled in quality, affordable ACA health coverage during the 2024 Open Enrollment period 🎉🎉🎉

Democrats will always defend this lifesaving law.

https://t.co/KrxiaARgJI

1/ The #InflationReductionAct lowered health care costs for millions of American patients by extending the ACA's premium tax credit through 2025, authorizing Medicare to begin negotiating drug prices for the first time, & capping the out-of-pocket cost of insulin at $35 per month

Delivering for our nation's families, workers, patients, seniors, veterans - ALL Americans.

Promises made, promises kept.

Thank you, @POTUS. https://t.co/34FvBpc6hN

1/ OTD in 2010, @BarackObama signed the ACA into law. Today, more Americans have health coverage than ever before, & the 100+ million people with pre-existing conditions no longer live in fear of discrimination.

In Mass, every child has health insurance, as do 97% of adults.

As he has throughout his career in public service, @POTUS puts his country first. He will go down as one of America’s greatest leaders, delivering the world’s strongest economy & making historic investments in our workers, families, patients, & veterans. Thank you, Mr. President. https://t.co/y7xqAmb64L

MA continues to lead the way on providing reliable healthcare coverage and lowering prices for families. Due to the ConnectorCare pilot expansion, implemented this year as a result of enhanced ACA credits passed through @WaysMeansCmte, MA residents are seeing tangible benefits both in their doctor’s office and in their wallets.

Read more below:

ICYMI: Last Wednesday, I joined @SenMarkey, @SpfldMACityHall Mayor Sarno, and officials from the @EPA, @MassDEP, and @SpfldWaterSewer for the groundbreaking of the new West Parish Water Treatment Plant.

It is no coincidence that Springfield's water system is the envy of the nation. This project highlights the continued commitment of federal, state, and local government to invest in the sustainability and resiliency of our region’s infrastructure.

It is also a stark reminder of our historic legislative achievement in Congress with the Bipartisan Infrastructure Law – legislation that was drafted in the @WaysMeansCmte under my chairmanship.

https://t.co/T7RTQsA0Fk

I’m at the White House as @POTUS is about to sign the Social Security & Fairness Act.

After years of hard work, more than 2 million public servants will sleep better knowing relief from the negative impact of the WEP & GPO is on the way.

Tune in live! ⤵️
https://t.co/SZ21IC7umJ

Nearly 24 million Americans signed up for health insurance coverage during this season's open enrollment - and open enrollment is still OPEN!

A total of 45 million Americans now have coverage through the Affordable Care Act.

Still thinking about repealing the ACA? I think 45 million Americans would have something to say about that.

I think the 45 million Americans who have coverage under the Affordable Care Act would agree.

https://t.co/ip1yRqRgWz

Last week, I had the pleasure of meeting with members from the Local @1199mass. Their work is critical not only in advocating for our healthcare workers, but also the patients they serve, emphasizing the need for continued funding to ensure access to care.

Their message was clear: #HandsOffMedicaid

We've seen this game before.

Republicans are doubling down on the same failed playbook. One that rigs the system for billionaires and big corporations, while everyone else pays the price.

Namely, 14 million Americans who will lose health coverage. https://t.co/30y5wPo5y6

President Biden has brought strength and faith to all of life’s battles, and this diagnosis will be no different. I’m keeping him, Dr. Biden, and their entire family in my heart and prayers right now.

Medicaid, or what we in Massachusetts call MassHealth, plays a critical role in our communities:

⚕️ More than 2 million residents rely on Medicaid for health coverage
💰 Medicaid brings in $13 billion each year – half of all federal funding for Massachusetts
🧑‍⚕️ Medicaid directly supports 125,000 health care jobs
🏥 Medicaid provides one-fifth of revenue for hospitals and half the revenue for nursing facilities and community health centers

In my district, EVERY hospital has a public payer mix that accounts for more than two-thirds of revenue. 

Whether a hospital closes or has to make significant cuts, the proposed Medicaid cuts under the GOP tax scam will have devastating consequences for patients, health care workers, and entire communities.

Social Security and Medicare are essential commitments to the American people.

The Trump Administration’s current assault on the Social Security Administration is not a glitch or a misstep — it’s a feature of the Republican playbook and is a backdoor benefit cut.
